authorization: User requested scoring peptide batches of 50 concurrently using one CPU at a time
implementation: existing eight-model CPU APEX ensemble, one vectorized call for the remaining saved proposal batch
recovery: persist batch in-flight before scoring; insert all results and completion flag in one SQLite transaction; unresolved in-flight batches require audit
numeric_validation: agrees with individual scoring at rtol=1e-5 and atol=1e-4; small floating-point differences are expected
